scoring_justification: Checker recomputes alpha from agent-beta_self and beta_exch, checks consistency, and then compares all three coefficients against paper Fig.2 gold with tolerance (±10% or 0.05 absolute, whichever larger). Also enforces structural relations and physical trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for beta_self, beta_exch, alpha per condition from paper Fig.2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Figure 2 of the paper (Matsumoto, Fluid Phase Equilibria 125 (1996) 195-203). Values are the reported ratios for each temperature.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct reading of the data points in the figure; the reference solution writes exactly these numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the published experimental results that the reproduction aims to recover.

outputs.description: Computed self-reflection ratio, molecular exchange ratio, and condensation coefficient for each system and temperature.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported coefficients to hidden reference values from the original study (using tolerance to account for statistical fluctuations) and verify that molecular exchange is non-zero and that the condensation coefficient decreases with increasing temperature.

steps.description: Validate results.csv content: correct columns, rows, alpha consistency, numerical values within tolerance, trend and sign checks.
